description: Decrypt AES-GCM ciphertext. algorithm must include name, iv, and tag (16 octets). additionalData must match encrypt if used. Requires execute access. Auth failure yields a generic decryption error.

parameters.description: AES-GCM parameters including required iv and tag.
parameters.name: algorithm

parameters.description: Key material, CryptoKey, or key reference.
parameters.name: key
